Name: Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][i][center][color=#fff2cc]A tidy and lively summit inspired Hilltop Farm, with some qql changes, tweaks and additions![/color][/center][/i][u][center][b]Big thanks to @clownedcat (Twitter) for commissioning me for this map and also kindly allowed me to upload this farm mod here on nexus![/b][/center][/u]
[center]This map inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko's[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15618]Zenith Farm[/url]﻿﻿, check it out if you want more spacious hilltop farm!
----------------------------------[/center][center][b][i][u][color=#ffe599]Note: [/color][/u][/i]there's 2 versions of this mod - one adds new hilltop farm as custom one (does not affect vanilla Hilltop farm). Another one works as replacement for vanilla Hilltop farm.
If you start your save file anew - I suggest using 1st version of the mod for avoiding issues with other farm mods.[/b][/center]
[/size][u][u][b][size=3]Features:[/size][/b][/u]
[/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]More tidy and overgrown Hilltop Farm map![/size]
[*][size=2]Beautiful summit view![/size]
[*][size=2]Forest forage spawn near secret woods entrance![/size]
[*][size=2]Additional small quarry map with working minecart! (You can also build farm buildings in there)[/size]
[*][size=2]Pathway to SVE Grandpha's Shed![/size]
[*][size=2]Custom starter giftbox items - (choose before starting new save file!)[/size]
[*][size=2]Ability to dig grass tiles![/size]
[*][size=2]Better fish catch pool - catch different types of fish depends on the water type![/size]
[*][size=2]Respawnable hardwood stumps - 1 stump respawns every day in left down corner of the map (3 stumps in total)[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Secret Woods and Cindersap Forest passages - adds warps to Woods and Forest maps (the forest one will warp you to tile behing the big pink tree). Secret Woods warp is blocked by Hardwood Log for more immersion.[/size]
[/list][list]
[/list][size=3][b][center][color=#fff2cc]This mod is for Stardew 1.6 only[/color][/center][/b][/size]
[b][size=3]Don't want respawnable stumps in farm or respawnable ore nodes in quarry map? [/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Go to your "Mods" folder, open "Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm", > "[FTM] Small Hilltop Farm" and open content.json file with any text editor.[/size]
[*][size=2]Find "LargeObjectSpawnEnabled" and "OreSpawnEnabled" and change it to "false"[/size]
[*][size=2]Save the changes.[/size]
[*][size=2]Done![/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Don't want fences, access to quarry map or small bridge to greenhouse?[/b] You can config all of it in my mod's config! (Use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod [/url][size=3]for more convenient ingame config)

[b]Since it's really tidy map, I recommend using [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6854][b]Build on Any Tile mod [/b][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url]
[/size]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/QoiZHAg.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Fences - true\false[/size]
[*][size=2]Farmhouse Rope Bridge - true\false[/size]
[*][size=2]Quarry Rope Bridge - true\false[/size]
[*][size=2]SVE Grandpha's Shed Warp - true/false[/size]
[*][size=2]Starter Gift - Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file.)[/size]
[*][size=2]Starter Giftbox items available: [/size]
[size=3] ﻿ [/size][quote] ﻿﻿- [size=1]Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿- Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿  ﻿-Mining - will give you 1 furnace and "Miner's Treat" food item
﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿ ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿ ﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/size][/quote][/list][size=3]
[img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img][/size]
[size=3][color=#d9ead3][b]Compatible[/b][/color] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...
[b][color=#d9ead3]Compatible[/color] [/b]with any recolors and retextures. 
[color=#ea9999][b]Not compatible[/b][/color] with any other mod that edits the Hilltop Farm (If Vanilla HIlltop Farm replacement is used)

[u][color=#ffe599][b]NOTE for SVE compatibility[/b][/color][/u] [b]- the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is [color=#ffe599]x = 36, y = 22 [/color]- change it in SVE config.[/b][/size]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip "Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b][center]Mods used on screenshots:[/center][/b][center]----------------------------
Vibrant Pastoral Recolor
VPR Temporary fix 1.6
Medieval DNT ( DaisyNiko's Tilesheets retexture )
Wildflower Grass
Simple Foliage
Better Water 2
Visible Fish
Stardew Valley Expanded
----------------------------[/center][/size][b][center][/center][/b]
